newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Air India to start Schiphol 747 combi service.
newsitem.headline: Air India to start Schiphol 747 combi service.

text.p: Air India will begin a Boeing 747 combi service from Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport on June 6.
Air India's cargo manager in the Netherlands, Herman Eikema, said it will be a weekly Friday flight and will be via Frankfurt before flying on to India.

With the new service Air India will operate three weekly flights ex-Frankfurt, two ex-Paris and one from Amsterdam. The Paris flights are also in combination with Frankfurt. Currently, the Indian carrier is off-line in the Netherlands.
"The Netherlands-India market is very busy at the moment," Eikema said.
Air India will also be increasing its rates in early May. Cargo rates are likely to rise by ten to 20 percent, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
